Lina_CSM: Hey team — kicking off Borealis onboarding. Customer wants a prod pilot in ~6 weeks. Need confirmed owners for model onboarding, infra/VPC, success metrics, enablement. Please reply with availability and owners.

Omar_PS: I can lead PS for config & runbooks. Available Mon-Wed mornings next two weeks.

Jia_ENG: I'll own model onboarding and canary rollout. Need infra/VPC details and access to model artifacts.

Sam_Security: I’ll take VPC/KMS sign-off. Can do an initial review this Friday (end of day).

Eli_Analytics: I'll define success criteria and build the eval harness. Quick Q — customer cares most about latency and intent accuracy, yes? Also want weekly scorecards.

Lina_CSM: @Eli_Analytics correct — customer targets: latency p50 <150ms, p95 <500ms; top-3 intent accuracy >92%; cost estimate target ~ $0.03/token. Weekly status and a short onboarding playbook requested.

Omar_PS: Proposed high-level timeline: 
```
Week 0: Kickoff & account access
Week 1-2: Model onboarding + infra setup + small-scale tests
Week 3: Pilot (10% traffic) + baseline metrics
Week 4-5: Iterate, performance tuning + canary to 50%
Week 6: Prod cutover and handoff
```
Can we compress any steps if infra is ready early?

Jia_ENG: We can parallelize infra and model prep. If VPC peering + GPU queue are ready by Friday, we can move pilot up one week. Need list of sample prompts and expected outputs from Eli.

deploy-bot: env/borealis-test: created by infra-team at 1767801450

Lina_CSM: Action items (assignments):
- Omar_PS: draft runbook + schedule enablement session with customer
- Jia_ENG: prepare model artifacts, canary config, and observability hooks
- Sam_Security: VPC/KMS review and sign-off
- Eli_Analytics: baseline eval plan and intent list for customer approval
I’ll compile these and send calendar invites once owners confirm availability.

Omar_PS: :thumbsup: I’ll share a runbook draft by EOD Thursday.

Jia_ENG: Can infra grant me read/write to the S3 bucket (borealis-artifacts) and add me to the dedicated GPU queue?

Sam_Security: @Jia_ENG added to allowlist; please verify access and post screenshots if any errors.

Eli_Analytics: I’ll draft the eval prompts and a templated weekly scorecard. Need customer to review the intent list — Lina, can you capture that in the kickoff?

Lina_CSM: Yep — I’ll include the PM in the invite. Proposed enablement session: next Wed 10:00 AM PT. Drop :white_check_mark: if that works, or propose alternatives.

Jia_ENG: :white_check_mark: works for me.

Omar_PS: :white_check_mark:

Sam_Security: I can do it but prefer 11am PT. If that's a blocker I can adjust.

Eli_Analytics: 10am okay.

Lina_CSM: Great — I’ll finalize invites and share a short agenda + the runbook link once Omar posts the draft. Thanks everyone!
